title.en: Parrot Fakes Sleep with a Phone

description.en: A lovebird hides its glowing phone and pretends to sleep when its owner approaches.

entries.prompt: A cinematic 8K live-action style video. A dimly lit bedroom late at night. With an extremely shallow depth of field (F1.2), only the parrot in the foreground is perfectly in focus, while the background is heavily blurred. No UI or text appears on screen. The protagonist is a small peach-faced lovebird with pale blue feathers, a white face, and vivid pink round cheek patches. It is nestled under a thick white quilt with a leaf pattern. The parrot extends its left foot from under the quilt, using its tiny claws to swipe at the glowing smartphone screen placed in front of it. The phone's light casts a pale blue glow on its face. Suddenly, sensing approaching footsteps, the parrot freezes instantly. Its eyes widen in alertness. The parrot quickly shoves the phone deep between its body and the quilt, completely hiding the light, then closes its eyes tightly and sinks deeply into the quilt, perfectly feigning sleep. Immediately after, in the heavily blurred background area, a wooden door opens, letting in warm orange light from the hallway. The silhouette of the owner, heavily blurred and unrecognizable, peers into the room. The parrot in the foreground remains perfectly in focus, motionless and holding its breath.

description.en: A close-range product orbit reveals a skeleton watch glowing above volcanic fissures.

entries.prompt: A high-end skeleton mechanical watch with a brushed titanium case and finely woven metal strap rests embedded within cracked volcanic rock, glowing rivers of molten lava flowing beneath and around it, casting an intense fiery orange illumination that radiates through the exposed inner mechanics of the dial. The scene opens in an ultra-tight macro shot, the camera positioned low and close, slowly tracking laterally along the lava fissure without any zoom-out, maintaining a compressed, intimate perspective as molten liquid pulses and flows beneath the watch, creating dynamic reflections that flicker across the sapphire crystal and polished metal edges. Heat distortion subtly warps the air above the lava, producing a realistic shimmer that bends light around the watch, while tiny sparks and embers rise slowly into the dark background, drifting with natural randomness. The camera transitions into a controlled micro-orbit at extremely close range, revealing the intricate movement of gears and complications inside the skeleton dial, with specular highlights gliding across brushed surfaces, beveled edges, and rotating components. The orange glow intensifies and fades rhythmically as the lava shifts, casting animated shadows through the internal structure of the watch, emphasizing depth and engineering precision. The strap shows slight thermal tension with minimal, believable movement, while surrounding rocks crack faintly, releasing subtle glowing fragments. A soft cinematic contrast between deep blacks and molten highlights enhances the premium, aggressive aesthetic. The sequence ends in a locked, razor-sharp hero close-up, centered on the watch face, with the lava’s glow breathing beneath it, embers floating in slow motion, and the entire composition radiating power, heat, and ultra-luxury craftsmanship.

title.en: Porcelain Swallows Dissolve into an Ink Abyss

description.en: A porcelain couture dress shatters into ink-wash swallows before the mirrored world collapses into a fluid vortex.

entries.prompt: A 15-second Hollywood haute couture fantasy film in 8K photorealistic quality, with a high-fashion editorial style and Unreal Engine 5 fluid rendering, featuring visual illusions. The scene is set on an endless salt flat mirror reflecting the sky, with oppressive dark clouds above and a minimalist cool-toned palette. [00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Haute couture entrance and porcelain skin. Camera position: extremely low-angle upward shot, using a telephoto lens to zoom in. Action: An Asian female model with a highly distinctive high-fashion face walks coolly across the water. Effect: Her dress is not made of fabric but of flowing liquid blue-and-white porcelain. As she walks, the skirt emits crisp clinking sounds like real ceramic, with a glossy surface and traditional blue patterns moving like living things across the white porcelain texture. [00:05-00:10] Shot 2: Physical shattering and ink arrival. Camera position: extreme close-up on the face, then quickly zooming out. Action: The model suddenly stops, coldly stares at the camera, and snaps her fingers crisply. Effect: At the snap, the blue-and-white porcelain dress does not fall but instantly shatters into thousands of highly realistic ink-wash swallows. These swallows, carrying real water droplets and ink marks, drag black fluid afterimages through the air, swirling wildly around her. [00:10-00:15] Shot 3: Dimensional dissolution and abyss reflection. Camera position: high-angle overhead shot, rapidly rotating and descending. Action: The flock of ink-wash swallows plunges into the mirror-like lake water beneath the model's feet. Effect: The originally solid salt lake surface instantly loses surface tension, and the entire highly realistic world begins to violently blur and dissolve like thick ink dripping into clear water. The real dark clouds and the model's figure transform into a grand 3D fluid ink vortex, completely engulfing the camera into a black-and-white abyss.

Every shot should feel rich in texture and movement, emphasizing fire, steam, glossy sauces, and elegant plating.

Use a sophisticated soundtrack that begins with a deep cinematic bass note and soft sizzling sounds. As the video progresses, layer in subtle orchestral strings, crisp kitchen Foley (fire crackles, pasta falling, wine swirl, chocolate drizzle), and end with a warm, satisfying musical resolve. The sizzling should remain audible throughout the cooking shots, blending naturally with the music.

Shot 1 — Steak Over Flame

Open with an extreme macro close-up of a thick steak searing over open fire. Bright orange flames dance around the meat, smoke curls upward, and rendered fat glistens on the charred crust.

Camera: Slow push-in.

 Transition: Flame flare naturally fills the frame and becomes the warm lighting of the next shot.

Top-down cinematic sweep over a beautifully arranged table featuring grilled salmon with asparagus and rice, creamy pasta, Greek salad, and steak with dipping sauce.

Camera: Smooth lateral pan.
 Audio: Music expands with soft strings and ambient restaurant sounds.
 Transition: Camera passes over a wine glass; the circular rim becomes the next shot.

Close-up of a glamorous blonde woman (late 20s, glowing skin, soft waves, glossy lips) holding a crystal wine glass and smiling subtly.
Camera: Gentle dolly in.

 Transition: She lowers her gaze toward the plate, cutting naturally to her hand.

Macro shot of her manicured hand with glossy red nails squeezing a charred lemon wedge over salmon. Slow-motion droplets sparkle as they fall.

Camera: Tilt down following the juice.
 Audio: Bright citrus squeeze sound.
 Transition: The falling droplets match the motion of pasta entering sauce.

Shot 5 — Pasta Cascade
Wide ribbons of fresh pasta tumble from a colander into creamy sauce in slow motion.
Camera: Overhead close-up.

 Transition: Steam fills the frame and reveals the next shot.

Close-up of salmon sizzling on a hot grill as a small flame ignites on its surface.

Camera: Subtle zoom in.

Rigatoni is stirred with tongs in rich glossy tomato sauce.

Camera: Circular overhead

title.en: Giant Whales in a Deep-Sea Dance

description.en: Two immense whales glide through a dark trench as macro skin detail gives way to a turbulent synchronized dive.

entries.prompt:
Scene: Deep sea trench - underwater
Quick editing

Atmosphere: awe-inspiring and raw. A peaceful giant moves perfectly in tranquil waters, its shockingly terrifying scale evoking a profound sense of solemnity and the primal power of nature.

Lens description:
A series of fast-paced, cinematic underwater shots capture the majestic movements and physical presence of the giant whale. The sequence starts from a wide angle, pushes into micro-details, captures the addition of a second whale, and ends with a powerful, turbulent exit.

Timeline / Shot by Shot:
0:00-0:03 - [Ultra-wide / 16mm / Slow drift]. A breathtaking silhouette of a giant whale floats in a vast liquid space. This massive creature smoothly cleared thousands of gallons of water.
Sound effects: deep, resonant bass frequencies from the depths of the ocean.

0:03-0:06 - [Push camera / smooth track]. The camera slowly shifts to the middle section of this massive creature. The visual proportions shift, revealing the texture of its skin like a mountain, covered with thick, pale, jagged barnacle clusters.
Sound effect: a deep, chest-shaking creature moan, gradually increasing in intensity.

0:06-0:09 - [Medium shot / slow panning]. The camera glides parallel to the whale. An ancient, wise eye, as big as a vehicle, loosely rotated the observation space. Microbubble vortices cascade down from its massive pectoral fins.
Sound effects: The gentle, rhythmic splash of water as it is physically pushed away.

0:09-0:12 - [Deep focus / Wide / Pan-shot]. A massive shadow slowly approaches from the deep-sea background, rising vertically. A second whale of equal size came into view, forming an astonishing side-by-side formation with the first. Their massive combined mass clearly alters the flow of water.
Sound effects: overlapping, mournful low-frequency calls echo.

0:12-0:15 - [Downward Shot / Turbulence]. Both whales began to dive downward in unison. The huge tail fin appears one after another in the frame. When the tails sweep downward, they create a huge local vortex. The camera shakes violently, perfectly swallowed by chaotic, explosive, rolling silver bubbles before the vision blurs.
Sound effects: Sudden, explosive water rushes through the wall and washes over the soundscape.

Technology and rendering:
- Camera: Floating cinematic equipment, smooth zero-gravity drift, sudden turbulence and camera shake during climax
- Lens: 16mm ultra-wide underwater dome port, deep depth of field
- Modifiers: Shot on 35mm film, photo-level realism, cinematic atmospheric lighting, high detail, original footage, cinematic, 8K resolution, volumetric rendering.

Microdetails and textures:
- Tightly packed serrated, calcified white barnacles attached to tough gray skin
- Shimmering silver microbubbles flow along the deep spine of the whale's ancient healing scars
- The physical weight of water visibly bends and washes through the enormous thrust of the side by side of the tail fins

Sound layer:
0:00-0:06: Heavy underwater pressure sounds and the moans of creatures vibrating the chest cavity
0:06-0:12: The sound of water stirring in fins, overlapping low frequencies echoing in the air
0:12-0:15: The rushing, heavy sound of water mixed into absolute solitude

description.en: Tiny chefs work continuously around a towering pancake stack as honey, berries, and powdered sugar animate a miniature bakery world.

entries.prompt:
A cinematic 10-second macro video inside a miniature bakery world built around a towering stack of fluffy golden pancakes covered with flowing honey, fresh strawberries, blueberries, mint leaves and powdered sugar. Tiny chefs continuously work without stopping, each performing a unique task. The camera movement is one continuous shot with no jump cuts or abrupt transitions.

The video opens with a smooth cinematic push-in from a medium-wide macro view toward the pancake tower. As the camera approaches, warm honey slowly drips over the pancakes while one chef pours fresh honey from a tiny bucket. The camera continues its forward movement and naturally begins a gentle clockwise orbit around the stack.

Without cutting, the orbit becomes faster as the camera glides past a chef carefully placing blueberries onto the honey-covered pancakes. Continuing the same motion path, the camera swoops slightly downward and circles upward to reveal another chef arranging sliced strawberries and fresh mint leaves on the top pancake.

The camera flows seamlessly toward the opposite side of the stack, passing close beside dripping honey before revealing a chef sweeping spilled powdered sugar from the tabletop. Maintaining the same continuous movement, the camera performs a dramatic low FPV fly-through between scattered berries and miniature tools, passing a chef pushing a wooden cart loaded with fresh strawberries and blueberries.

The movement rises smoothly into a higher orbit, revealing another chef dusting powdered sugar from a ladder while honey glistens under warm golden light. The camera continues its uninterrupted circular flight, weaving naturally between ladders, scaffolding and workers, creating beautiful parallax while every chef remains busy with their own task.

For the final seconds the orbit widens into a spectacular cinematic 360-degree hero shot around the completed pancake tower. Honey cascades down every layer, berries shine with fresh moisture, powdered sugar floats through the air, all miniature chefs continue working simultaneously, warm bakery atmosphere, shallow depth of field, macro photography, volumetric lighting, smooth FPV drone movement, elegant speed ramps, cinematic motion blur, ultra-realistic textures, premium food commercial quality, seamless continuous camera movement, no cuts, no text, no logos, 9:16.

description.en: A consistent protagonist moves through a calm morning routine, exercise, balcony gardening, and warm natural light.

entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic lifestyle video featuring the same young woman throughout the entire sequence. Maintain perfect identity consistency across every shot, preserving identical facial features, hairstyle, body proportions, skin tone, outfit, accessories, and overall appearance.

She wears a white ribbed crop top, beige cotton shorts, white ankle socks, and a messy high ponytail.

The setting is a bright, modern apartment filled with warm golden morning sunlight, wooden furniture, soft neutral décor, large windows with sheer curtains, and abundant indoor plants, creating a calm Scandinavian-inspired atmosphere.

The video begins with her naturally waking up beside her bed. She stretches gently as soft golden sunlight pours through the sheer curtains. She smiles peacefully, takes a deep breath, and walks into the bathroom.

Inside the bathroom, she gently washes her face before beginning her complete skincare routine in front of the mirror. She carefully applies serum, massages moisturizer into her skin with slow circular motions, and admires her healthy natural glow with a relaxed smile.

She then walks into the living room, picks up a cordless vacuum cleaner, and begins cleaning the apartment. While vacuuming, she playfully dances around the room, laughing naturally and enjoying the quiet morning. Sunlight streams through the large windows, casting soft realistic shadows across the wooden floor.

Next, she opens the sliding balcony door and steps outside carrying a watering can. She carefully waters rows of colorful flower pots and lush green plants. She gently touches the petals and leaves while enjoying the peaceful morning breeze. Butterflies flutter nearby as warm sunlight illuminates the flowers.

After finishing, she prepares a large iced coffee and sits comfortably on a balcony chair surrounded by blooming plants. She quietly enjoys the panoramic city skyline, closes her eyes for a moment to feel the warm breeze, then notices the camera. She smiles softly, raises her coffee toward the lens in a friendly toast, and relaxes as the camera slowly pulls back to reveal the peaceful balcony garden bathed in morning light.

Audio should consist only of natural ambient sounds: birds chirping, a gentle breeze, distant city ambience, footsteps, running water, vacuum cleaner sounds, leaves rustling, water pouring onto plants, and ice softly clinking inside the coffee. No background music.

No subtitles, logos, watermarks, captions, or on-screen text.

Style: Premium sports broadcast realism, natural lighting mixed with powerful stadium floodlights, ultra-detailed snow spray, realistic gravity, momentum, and landing impact, crisp winter air, high-speed action photography. 0-4 seconds: Wide establishing shot + slow crane down, cat accelerates towards the ramp, board edges create clear lines in the snow, snow particles are blown towards the camera, anticipation murmurs from the stands. 4-9 seconds: Side tracking shot, cat enters the final ramp and launches into a powerful pop and long jump, body remains balanced, tail and paws react realistically to airflow, long airtime, natural physics. 9-13s: Dramatic telephoto slow motion, artistic spin and stylish grab in mid-air, stadium lights passing underneath, detailed fur movement, snow crystals and cold breath particles, Olympic final moment energy. 13-15s: Low angle follow shot into landing, solid and satisfying landing, board settles on the ground, a dense cloud of snow rises, the cat continues to glide in the flow, spectators rise to their feet and respond with powerful applause and cheers, final hero frame, triumphant winter sports atmosphere.

description.en: A pianist performs on a mountaintop cliff in a continuous cinematic shot that moves from sweeping landscape to tactile keyboard detail.

entries.prompt:
single continuous shot, one take no cuts, cinematic oner, cinematic lighting, photorealistic, 35mm film quality, professional color grading, sharp focus, high detail texture, film grain, depth of field mastery, steadicam fluidity
Photorealistic live-action, not animation: an epic mountaintop cliff above a vast sea of glowing clouds at golden hour, distant jagged peaks catching warm light. A young woman pianist in a long flowing gown plays a black grand piano with intense expressive emotion, body swaying, hands flying across the keys, hair and dress whipping violently in a rising wind, while flocks of birds sweep upward through shafts of god-light and embers and petals swirl through the gusting air. The single take is built as one aggressive FPV descent — banking flight, a plunge into the piano's resonant interior, then an explosive pull-back to epic scale — with warm golden light, anamorphic flares, and volumetric beams held consistent so feather, ember, skin, and string textures all read in razor 4K macro detail.

Single continuous shot 15s: The camera banks fast and low around the cliff edge through churning golden clouds, embers and petals streaking past the lens as it swings toward the pianist, her gown and hair whipping in the wind, hands flying across the keys. Accelerating forward, the camera dives straight into the open piano lid and ramps to slow motion as it threads the tight gap between copper-wound strings and felt hammers, the hammers striking and the strings shivering in pore-deep macro detail, dust and light vibrating in the resonant wooden interior. Then the camera bursts back out of the piano, snapping to full speed as it pulls away and rises, birds sweeping upward through shafts of light, until it settles into a soaring extreme wide that reveals the whole cliff, the lone pianist, and the endless sea of glowing clouds below.
Total: 15s / 1 shot / 16:9

description.en: A cheetah emerges from golden grass and accelerates across the savanna in a long-lens wildlife tracking sequence.

entries.prompt: [Style] National Geographic African Wildlife documentary, 4K Ultra HD, ultra-telephoto lens (800mm Telephoto), high-speed tracking vehicle (Tracking Vehicle 120fps), golden hour light on the East African savanna. [Duration] 10 seconds. [Scene] Dusk on the East African savanna, golden dry grass waist-high, a giant acacia tree silhouetted against the skyline, the sun hanging low on the horizon bathing the entire plain in deep gold, heat haze distorting the distance. [00:00-00:04] Shot 1: Eyes in the grass (Telephoto Close-Up 800mm, Shallow DOF). Ultra-telephoto shallow depth-of-field close-up: golden grass fills the entire frame, with no animal visible at all. Suddenly, through a gap in the grass, a pair of amber eyes appears—a female cheetah crouched low in the grass, only her eyes to the tips of her ears rising above the blades. The black tear marks on her face run from the inner corners of her eyes down to the corners of her mouth, her nose rough black leather in texture. Her pupils contract sharply into vertical slits—locking onto prey. Her ears press slightly back, flattening against her skull. The foreground and background grass blur into golden bokeh, leaving only the cheetah's eyes razor-sharp and clear. [00:04-00:07] Shot 2: Full burst (High-Speed Tracking 120fps, Side Profile). High-speed side tracking shot: the cheetah explodes from the grass into a full sprint, reaching 100 kilometers per hour. In slow-motion, her spine bends like a spring to its extreme then fully extends—curving so that her hind legs pass her front legs, then stretching her body into a horizontal line with all four paws airborne. With each push-off, the dry grass and red earth beneath her paw pads are kicked up in fan-shaped sprays. The white short fur on her belly ripples in waves with the rhythm of her stride, her tail swinging to one side like a rudder during high-speed turns to maintain balance. Her facial muscles are taut, her mouth slightly open revealing canines, nostrils flared wide. [00:07-00:10] Shot 3: Conclusion in dust (Super Slow-mo, Head-On Tracking). Head-on ultra-slow-motion tracking shot: the cheetah charges straight toward the camera at full speed, kicking up a three-meter-high trail of golden dust behind her. She abruptly pivots sideways—all four paws gouging four furrows in the ground, her body nearly rolling horizontal to the earth, her tail arcing in the opposite direction. In the instant of the turn, the dust she throws up forms a curved golden wall, the setting sun backlighting it, illuminating each particle as floating golden stardust. The cheetah's silhouette bursts out from the dust wall and gradually dissolves into the golden rays of the setting sun.

description.en: A young woman cycles, sketches, and wanders through quiet Tokyo neighborhoods in a reflective twilight slow-living film.

entries.prompt:
SUBJECT : Young Japanese woman, early 20s, natural refined everyday look. Oversized cream cardigan over a white tee, wide-leg light denim, plain leather loafers, hair in a low loose ponytail with a few soft strands framing her face. Minimal makeup, realistic skin, calm and warm reflective presence. Keep her identity, clothing, and hair consistent all the way through.
SETTING: A quiet Japanese shitamachi neighborhood, soft overcast late afternoon. Narrow lanes
between low houses, potted plants along the doorsteps, a small canal with a low
footbridge, power lines overhead, a parked mamachari, a quiet corner shrine, a red
mailbox on the corner. Lived-in and peaceful — no stores, no crowds, no tourists.
LOOK: Cinematic slice-of-life vlog. Composed, intentional framing, quiet and observational.
Soft muted natural tones, cool and gentle, realistic skin. Shallow depth of field,
fine film grain, soft natural light. Smooth cinematic camera movement throughout —
calm, unhurried, letting each moment breathe.
SEQUENCE: [0–3s]
She rides a mamachari slowly down the quiet lane, cardigan and loose strands drifting
in the breeze. The camera travels beside her, power lines sliding past overhead.
sound: soft bicycle wheels / distant cicadas / gentle wind / faint neighborhood ambience
[3–5s]
She stops at the low footbridge over the canal, rests her arms on the railing, and
gazes down at the still water. The camera moves gently toward her and past her shoulder
to the water.
sound: quiet water / cicadas / a faraway train / soft wind
[5–8s]
She sits on the shrine steps, opens a small notebook, and writes something slowly,
pausing to think. The camera moves evenly around her, focus soft on her hands then
her face.
sound: pen on paper / cicadas softening / wind through leaves / distant wind chime
[8–11s]
She crouches by a doorway and gently lifts a red furin wind chime, watching it turn.
The camera rises slowly from the chime up to her face.
sound: single clear furin chime / soft breeze / cicadas / faint chatter
[11–13s]
She walks along the lane holding a cold canned tea, the red mailbox passing softly
behind her. The camera moves ahead of her at an even pace, keeping her centered.
sound: unhurried footsteps / cicadas / distant bicycle bell / wind
[13–15s]
She reaches a quiet stone stairway, climbs the first steps, and glances back over her
shoulder with a small calm smile before continuing up into the softening light.
sound: footsteps on stone / cicadas / soft wind / slow fade
AUDIO: Natural ambient only — summer cicadas, quiet canal water, a distant train, wind through
the power lines, a single furin chime, unhurried footsteps, faint neighborhood ambience.
FEEL: A serene, composed afternoon in a quiet Japanese neighborhood — smooth, warm in feeling
but cool in tone, an unhurried and beautiful slice of everyday life.
